title: RevisionDojo Question Bank Review: Quality and…
summary: Read an honest RevisionDojo question bank review covering question quality, syllabus alignment, QA, feedback accuracy, limitations, and study use.
body_markdown:
A fair **RevisionDojo question bank review** must separate three issues: whether questions reflect the IB syllabus, whether solutions and mark logic are accurate, and whether feedback can be treated like official marking. RevisionDojo performs strongly as a structured source of topic-specific, IB-style practice because questions connect to worked reasoning, mark schemes, feedback, and performance tracking.


It should not be treated as infallible or official. RevisionDojo publishes a multi-perspective quality assurance process, but not an item-level accuracy percentage supporting claims such as “100% accurate.” Students should use the bank as a high-quality practice resource while checking questionable answers, ambiguous wording, and important syllabus details against current guidance or their teacher.


### RevisionDojo question bank review at a glance


The question bank is most useful for students who want more than disconnected practice questions. Its main strength is the learning cycle: select a topic, attempt a question, inspect the solution, identify why marks were lost, and practise the skill again.


Area Overall assessment Important qualification


Syllabus relevance Strong Select the correct subject, syllabus version, and SL or HL level.


Exam-style wording Generally strong IB-style questions are not official IB examination questions.


Worked solutions Useful for learning methods A solution may show one valid route rather than every acceptable route.


Markscheme alignment Helpful for understanding marks Platform feedback is not an official examiner decision.


Topic filtering Strong for targeted revision Narrow practice must eventually be combined with mixed papers.


Quality assurance More substantial than unreviewed generation No published item-level error rate proves every question is correct.


Error correction Students can report questions A reporting system does not prevent all errors.


The balanced conclusion is that **RevisionDojo question quality is suitable for regular IB preparation** , provided students continue to apply judgment. This is particularly important for essay interpretations, alternative mathematical methods, scientific conventions, and syllabus transitions.


### What makes a high-quality IB question?


A question can be factually correct but still provide poor preparation. Effective IB practice must test the correct content at the appropriate level while developing skills assessed in the examination.


### Syllabus alignment and command terms


A useful question should correspond to the correct course, level, and assessment model. An accurate HL question may be inappropriate for an SL student, while material written for an earlier syllabus may emphasize content or paper structures that no longer apply.


RevisionDojo organizes its[IB Question Bank](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/questionbank) by subject and topic, with filters that support focused practice. Before starting, confirm the subject title, SL or HL designation, and first-assessment year where relevant.


IB command terms indicate the required response. **State** normally calls for a concise answer, **explain** requires reasons or causes, and **evaluate** requires a supported judgment. The IB’s official[Assessment principles and practices](https://ibo.org/contentassets/1cdf850e366447e99b5a862aab622883/assessment-principles-and-practices-2018-en.pdf) explains how command terms communicate expected response depth. Accurate task wording matters because students must answer the question asked rather than write everything they know.


### Mark allocation and explanations


Marks should correspond reasonably to the work expected. A 2-mark prompt should not demand an essay, while a substantial evaluation cannot be answered properly with one unsupported sentence.


RevisionDojo’s[Question Bank feature overview](https://www.revisiondojo.com/features/questionbank) describes worked reasoning, mark schemes, Jojo AI feedback, topic and difficulty filters, and accuracy tracking. These features are valuable because improvement depends on understanding where each mark comes from, not merely seeing a final answer.


In mathematics and science, a useful solution normally includes substitutions, intermediate steps, units, and a final answer. For essay subjects, guidance should identify relevant knowledge, analysis, evidence, and judgment without implying that one model paragraph is the only acceptable response.


### RevisionDojo’s quality assurance process


RevisionDojo’s published[accuracy review](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/is-revisiondojo-accurate) says its materials are designed around current IB syllabuses, criteria, command terms, and exam-style practice. It states that review involves **IB examiners, experienced teachers, alumni, and current students** .


The platform’s[Content Philosophy](https://www.revisiondojo.com/content-philosophy) assigns complementary roles to different reviewers:


- **Current students** assess clarity and cognitive load.
- **Alumni** assess examination relevance.
- **Teachers** assess technical accuracy.
- **Examiner perspectives** contribute knowledge of assessment expectations and mark allocation.


This is a credible editorial framework, but its limits matter. The published pages do not provide a complete item-level audit, a measured error rate for the entire bank, or evidence that every question is approved independently by every reviewer group. The process supports reasonable confidence, not a numerical guarantee of universal accuracy.


### How accurate are the questions and feedback?


Accuracy is not one property. Students should distinguish the fixed prompt, worked solution, mark scheme, and generated feedback.


Component What accuracy means How to use it


Question prompt Facts, data, wording, topic tag, and command term are appropriate. Check anything ambiguous, outdated, or apparently outside the course.


Worked solution The reasoning reaches a valid answer by an acceptable method. Verify assumptions, notation, units, and alternative methods.


Mark scheme The points reasonably represent how marks are earned. Other valid answers may also deserve credit.


Jojo AI feedback The response is interpreted against expected mark logic. Treat comments and marks as formative guidance.


Accuracy analytics Recorded answers reveal performance patterns. Results depend on marking quality and test conditions.


Objective questions usually allow straightforward verification. Students can repeat a calculation, substitute the result into the original relationship, or check dimensions independently.


Extended responses involve more judgment. Two history essays may use different evidence, while two English analyses may reach distinct defensible interpretations. Feedback is most useful when it identifies missing reasoning, evidence, comparison, or evaluation rather than presenting one response as uniquely correct.


Jojo AI can explain why an answer missed a mark and suggest improvements. Its decisions should still be treated as **formative feedback** , especially for nuanced essays and borderline judgments. Teachers and official assessment materials remain the stronger authorities when a disagreement affects an important school decision.


### Limitations students should understand


RevisionDojo is independent and is not endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization. Its exam-style questions develop relevant skills, but they are not automatically official questions and cannot guarantee the context or emphasis of a future paper.


No large question bank should be assumed to be error-free. Diagrams can fail, answer choices can be mistagged, conventions can vary, and syllabus updates can make older wording less useful. RevisionDojo provides a[question reporting process](https://www.revisiondojo.com/help-center/report-content-error) for inaccurate information, broken figures, formatting errors, and incorrect topic placement.


Topic drills also do not reproduce a complete examination. Filtering questions from one subtopic helps repair a weakness, but it removes the need to identify the topic independently. Students still need timed mixed practice to develop recognition, pacing, stamina, and transitions between unfamiliar tasks.


Platform accuracy statistics are diagnostic indicators, not direct IB grade predictions. An untimed score achieved with notes or hints cannot be compared directly with performance under examination conditions.


### How to evaluate the bank yourself


Students can conduct a small personal audit rather than accepting broad promotional claims or rejecting the resource because of one disputed answer.


1. **Choose the correct course.** Confirm the subject, syllabus version, level, and paper type.
2. **Sample varied questions.** Include calculations, short responses, data analysis, and extended tasks where applicable.
3. **Attempt them independently.** Do not let the solution shape your first response.
4. **Inspect the mark logic.** Check whether the command term, marks, and credited steps fit together.
5. **Cross-check a sample.** Use current guidance, class materials, textbooks, or teacher advice.
6. **Test disputed answers.** Recalculate results or identify alternative defensible interpretations.
7. **Report genuine errors.** Include the subject, topic, wording, and proposed correction.


A sample of **15-20 varied questions** cannot establish a scientific accuracy rate, but it can show whether the bank suits your course. Repeat the check for different subjects because marking complexity varies considerably between calculations and open-ended responses.


### Using RevisionDojo effectively


RevisionDojo’s guide to[using an IB question bank effectively](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/ib-question-bank-or-how-to-use-it-effectively) recommends focused sets, immediate review, mistake classification, and later reattempts. A practical session is to complete **10-15 questions** without notes, classify each lost mark, repair the relevant gap, and reattempt a similar task after 24-48 hours.


Classify errors as knowledge, method, interpretation, command-term, or careless mistakes. Use Study Notes or Flashcards only after identifying the gap, and ask Jojo AI for clarification when a solution step remains unclear. Later, test the same skill in a mixed, timed paper.


As examinations approach, combine drills with[RevisionDojo mock exam practice](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/revisiondojo-mock-exams) . This prevents students from becoming accurate only when the topic is announced in advance.


### Final verdict


RevisionDojo offers a strong question bank for targeted IB practice through syllabus organization, exam-style prompts, worked reasoning, mark guidance, feedback, and progress tracking. Its published QA framework provides more assurance than anonymous or entirely unreviewed question generation, but it does not prove every item is flawless.


Use RevisionDojo for regular practice and diagnosis while consulting teachers and current official guidance for consequential disagreements. A balanced routine should combine the Question Bank with Study Notes, Flashcards, Jojo AI, and Mock Exams rather than relying on any single tool.
